title: Daily Chief Inspector Report
contractor: West Tech Energy — Jose Salaises, Director of Operations

sections.heading: Summary of the Day
paragraphs: Today was a half day ahead of the Thanksgiving break. All of the 8" flare header, 8"-FL-12100-151S, is now welded out (55 welds per the IFC isometrics), and NDE will be on site Monday 11/30 to x-ray all of the 8" welds. We received the flare anchor details for the updated anchoring drawing. The flare will use two 7/8" F1554 Grade 36 anchor bolts per leg (six total) with heavy hex nuts and washers, 1'-9" long, with 15" embedment and 4" projection, plus one shear hairpin per leg. The existing flare base plate holes are 3/4", so the field will need to drill them out to 15/16" for the larger bolts.

The updated detail drawing is still coming. Before we set anchors I want the drawing to confirm the bolt length (1'-9" against 15" embedment plus 4" projection), who furnishes the anchors and hairpins, and Encore's acceptance of drilling their base plates. The fuel gas spools remain on hold pending Tegre's revised isometrics. The crew is off Thursday through Sunday. I also reviewed the hold markups Joel issued: six fuel gas isometric sheets are red-lined "do not fabricate," while the 8" flare header and the first two sheets of 2"-FG-12120-151 can proceed. The red-lines reference a second hold drawing (DWG. 2) that we have not received, and the ISO title blocks still show 20% X-ray even though MPLX has directed 100% RT; I have asked for both to be confirmed.

rows: No safety information in today's sources.
Flare anchor details received (7/8" F1554 Gr 36, 15" embedment, 4" projection, shear hairpin per leg). Updated detail drawing pending. Field work not recorded.
Platforms deferred to January per schedule.
8"-FL-12100-151S welded out — all 6 ISO sheets, 55 welds. RT of all 8" welds scheduled Mon 11/30. Red-lined fuel gas spools remain on hold.
Existing flare base plate holes (3/4") to be drilled to 15/16" for the new anchors.
May start now; completion in January.
